issues: Scene 001: The summary says the plates were found by Limhi’s people, but Ether 1:2 specifies only that the twenty-four plates were found by them; it does not say they found the record itself. The claimed present-day-narrator visual is a reasonable inference, not an explicit setting.
Scene 010: Jared’s second dialogue excerpt omits the preceding source phrase “And if it so be,” so it is not contiguous verbatim verse text as required.
Scene 011: The Lord’s quoted excerpt omits the source sentence’s opening “And” and therefore is not an exact contiguous quotation.

Scene 012: The quoted excerpt from Ether 1:43 is truncated before the sentence ends, omitting its punctuation; under the instruction to preserve exact excerpts without alteration, it is not a complete exact quotation.
